question: Which divine figure is invoked through these epithets in the mantra?
premises: The king of birds is named
The son of Vinatā is named
The banner of Nārāyaṇa is named
inference: These epithets invoke Garuḍa as the divine protector.
plain_english: The king of birds, son of Vinatā, likewise the banner of Nārāyaṇa.
